Uses of Package
org.ddolib.common.solver.stat

Packages that use org.ddolib.common.solver.stat
Package
Description
org.ddolib.common.solver.stat
Provides classes for tracking and representing the statistics and status of a search process in a solver.
org.ddolib.common.solver.stopcriterion
Provides interfaces and classes for defining termination criteria (stop criteria) for search processes.
org.ddolib.common.util.io
Input file reader utility
org.ddolib.layered.modeling
This package contains the interfaces and abstract classes that must be implemented as problem specific classes to model a problem with the layered API (fixed, known number of variables).
org.ddolib.layered.solver
This package contains the Solver interface implemented by every layered solver, and the Solution wrapper used to report a solution as a sequence of Decision.
org.ddolib.layered.solving.acs.core.solver
This package implements the Acs (Anytime Column Search) solver for the layered API.
org.ddolib.layered.solving.astar.core.solver
This package implements the A* solver for the layered API.
org.ddolib.layered.solving.awastar.core.solver
This package implements the Anytime Weighted A* solver for the layered API.
org.ddolib.layered.solving.ddo.core.solver
This package contains solvers using the DDO (Branch-and-Bound with decision diagrams) algorithm for the layered API: SequentialSolver (full DDO with relaxed and restricted MDDs), ExactSolver (exact MDD only), and RelaxationSolver / RestrictionSolver (a single relaxed/restricted MDD, mainly used internally and for testing bounds).
org.ddolib.layered.solving.lns.core.solver
This package implements the LNS (Large Neighborhood Search) solver, layered API only.
org.ddolib.nolayer.modeling
This package contains the interfaces and abstract classes that must be implemented as problem specific classes to model a problem with the no-layer API (no fixed number of variables, termination detected via Problem.isTarget(Object)).
org.ddolib.nolayer.solver
This package contains the Solver interface implemented by every no-layer solver, and the Solution wrapper used to report a solution as a list of decisions.
org.ddolib.nolayer.solving.acs.core.solver
This package implements the Acs (Anytime Column Search) solver for the no-layer API.
org.ddolib.nolayer.solving.astar.core.solver
This package implements the A* solver for the no-layer API, together with its own SubProblem, representing a node in the A* search tree.
org.ddolib.nolayer.solving.awastar.core.solver
This package implements the Anytime Weighted A* solver for the no-layer API.
org.ddolib.nolayer.solving.ddo.core.solver
This package contains DdoSolver, the DDO (Branch-and-Bound with decision diagrams) solver for the no-layer API.
